title: ACOS Run Manifest
description: Agentic Coding Orchestration Schema, version 0.1. Describes how one agentic coding run will be executed, before any worker model spends tokens.

acos.description: Schema version this manifest conforms to.

id.description: Run identifier. Generated by the orchestrator. Used as the run directory name.

intent.description: One or two sentence summary of what the user asked for.

preset.description: Name of the preset this manifest was derived from, if any.

stages.description: Ordered list of stages. Executed in order.

Adapter.description: How a stage is executed. inline: the orchestrator does it in-session. subagent: a subagent of the same harness. workflow: the harness workflow engine. external: a shell command or API call to another provider.

Effort.description: Provider-agnostic effort level, on delegated stages only. Adapters map it to provider-specific settings through the provider's effort_map; a level must be one the model lists under effort in the provider catalog. inherit, the default when absent, sets nothing: the worker runs at its runner's default. An inline stage runs at the session's effort, which no manifest can change.

OnFail.description: What to do when a stage check fails.

provider.description: Catalog provider key. Defaults to the project provider.

model.description: Id the tier's alias resolves to at compose time, or the alias when the session cannot tell.

Scope.description: Advisory hints about where the work is expected to happen. All fields optional.

include.description: Paths the work is expected to touch.

exclude.description: Paths the work should not modify.

command.description: Shell command. Exit code 0 means pass. Required when kind is command.

criteria.description: What a reviewer judges. Required when kind is review.

block.description: Catalog block this stage instantiates. Optional if role is given.

role.description: One line describing what this stage does. Required if block is absent.

provider.description: Catalog provider key. Delegated stages only; must be absent when adapter is inline.

tier.description: Role tier the adapter invokes through its alias. Delegated stages only; must be absent when adapter is inline.

model.description: Id the tier's alias resolves to at compose time, written fresh by the orchestrator, or the alias itself when it cannot tell. Delegated stages only; must be absent when adapter is inline.

inputs.description: Names of prior stage outputs this stage reads.

outputs.description: Names of artifacts this stage produces.

owns.description: Files or directories only this stage writes. Required on a delegated stage that runs alongside another; concurrent stages' owns must be disjoint.

escalation.description: Ordered models to try when on_fail is escalate.

gate.description: Pause for user confirmation before this stage runs.

prompt.description: Extra instructions appended to the block prompt for the worker.

then.description: An inline stage runs in the orchestrating session, whose provider, tier, model and reasoning effort are fixed for the whole session. Delegate the stage, or run it in a session set up for it.

Loop.description: Manifest-level loop defaults. Stage values override.

go.description: required: wait for explicit GO. auto: only valid from project-level config, never from a preset.

WorkClass.description: Class used to choose a calibrated reservation. Command-only work reserves zero model tokens; mechanical work does not scale with deleted line count.

coordination_tokens.description: Briefing, reading worker reports, evaluating checks and writing handoffs.

reserved_tokens.description: startup_tokens + work_tokens + coordination_tokens. Compared only with this lane's limit_tokens.

startup_included.description: Worker reservations are end-to-end and include the worker startup load.

limit_tokens.description: The per-worker context ceiling copied from limits.worker_context_tokens.

Estimate.description: Conservative compose-time context reservation, not usage already spent or a point forecast. Fit is evaluated per context lane. Observed usage remains null until execution reports a measurement.

files.description: Files created or edited, tests included.

calibration.description: fallback when no applicable calibration.md measurement exists; project when project calibration supplied the figures.

aggregate_reserved_tokens.description: Conservative sum across the orchestrator and all workers. Useful for volume or cost analysis, never for comparison with a per-context limit.

observed_tokens.description: Always null in a compose-time estimate. Measured actuals belong in the run log or plan actual record.

run_dir.description: Where manifest and log are written. Default runs/<id>.

Limits.description: Advisory ceilings for one run. Act at compose time only: split large intents into a plan and cap delegation. Not checked mid-run; calibrate compares them with actual afterwards.

files.description: Files created or edited by one context (an inline part, or one slice of a fan-out), tests included. A session running several slices legitimately totals more.

lines.description: Lines added plus removed, per context, with the same meaning as files.

orchestrator_tokens.description: Context the orchestrating session may spend, its startup load included. What is left for the work is this minus config.yaml startup.orchestrator.

worker_context_tokens.description: Per-worker context ceiling. Every worker reservation is compared with this value independently.

worker_tokens_total.description: Optional aggregate ceiling across workers in one run. Omit when only per-context fit matters.

agents.description: Subagent, workflow agent or external calls per run.

Part.description: Present when this manifest is one part of a plan (runs/<plan>/plan.yaml). Parts run in order, each in its own session.

plan.description: Plan id; the plan file is runs/<plan>/plan.yaml.

after.description: Indices of the parts this one waits for. Default: the part before it. Empty means it may start at any time; parts not downstream of each other may run in separate sessions at once.

assumes.description: What this part expects earlier parts to have left in the tree. Checked before GO.

deferred_to.description: Later part that must carry and capture these claims. Valid only when this part also passes deterministic verification.

covers_parts.description: Earlier parts whose deferred claims this part captures.

Design.description: Present when the work follows a design. The contract stage transcribes the sources into numbered acceptance lines; a part does not close with a line left open.

sources.description: Every artboard, mockup, exported render or note the work follows: a repo path or a canvas URL. Copied under runs/<id>/design/ by the contract stage.

contract.description: Where the contract stage writes the numbered lines. Default runs/<id>/artifacts/design-contract.md.

Tier.description: Role tier. The provider catalog maps it to an alias: a floating name the runner keeps current, or the model id for a runner without one. Blocks, presets and project config never name a model id.
